key_point: What Ubisoft did after Notre-Dame burned
title: What Ubisoft did after Notre-Dame burned
caption: After the 2019 Notre-Dame fire, Ubisoft gave Assassin's Creed Unity away free and donated to the rebuild. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #assassinscreed #acunity

instagram.caption:
Assassin's Creed Unity recreated Notre-Dame in incredible detail. One artist reportedly spent about two years on the cathedral.

In April 2019 the real Notre-Dame caught fire and its spire collapsed while the world watched.

Ubisoft gave Unity away free on PC for a week so people could explore it, and pledged 500,000 euros to restore it.

Did you climb it in the game?
